identity: One playable blonde protagonist; NOT a new character or a different face for equipment classes

head.hair: short cream-gold swept bangs and recognizable raised tufts
head.face: same accepted pale youthful face/eyes across all classes

silhouette.base: approved playable character; do not scale heads or bodies per animation
silhouette.comparison: measure from actual accepted source; do not enforce a new ratio incompatible with original

socket_contract: Approximate per-facing inspection guide inside accepted full-body pixels. Weapon grip follows authored frame pose; never move projectile collision or fake independent weapon bones using these static hints.
state_clock: GameCore authoritative released/contact, walkDistance; no independent clip damage clock
integration: CanonicalHeroSpriteFactory uses foot/head constants; Editor builder uses shared pivot; live SpriteRenderer capture uses shared geometry and SortingGroup; OnGUI fallback retained.
quality_gate: Native Unity Editor/PlayMode, weapon hand grips, anatomy, frame continuity, visuals, and real-world FPS require independent review
head_to_body_ratio_policy: Reuse the accepted 56px canonical head source and full-body silhouettes; do not invent ratio from canvas padding or rescale professions.

animation_constraints.golden_protagonist_identity: Same short cream-gold hair and approved face/eye pixels in all three outfits; no per-class head scaling
animation_constraints.source_motion: One approved silhouette per generated in-between, locked blonde head and rooted boot contact
animation_constraints.timing_authority: GameCore's ActorAction.released; never drive damage from Animator
animation_constraints.moving_recovery: Keep UnifiedActionGait authored walk legs and gameplay movement rules
animation_constraints.safety_fallback: Opt-in SpriteRenderer/Animator with existing OnGUI route on failure
animation_constraints.final_gate: Native Unity 2022.3.53f1 PlayMode + visually accepted frame-to-frame anatomy and weapon grips required
animation_constraints.reaction_transition_policy: All three accepted frames preserved verbatim; one full-body, root/head-locked source-raster in-between per transition; GameCore still owns invulnerability, displacement and stun.

motion_registration.source_canvas: accepted 256x256 RGBA world sprite from the current one blonde hero
motion_registration.coordinates: Unity bottom origin; y=0 at ground-side edge
motion_registration.pixel_source_policy: Nearest-neighbor resampling of the preceding accepted pose only: no two-pose color blend or alpha Bayer dither
motion_registration.review_only: Non-identical inbetween counts validate raster motion, not anatomical quality or authored keyframes

full_body_source_contract.canonical_protagonist: Same approved golden-haired hero in every outfit; identity source exception is face/hair only, never torso or equipment
full_body_source_contract.shared_row_owner: frame_index // 4 must equal zero-based profession index

shared_golden_head_only.policy: RETIRED - no head substitution permitted in preview, game runtime, native Unity fallback, or offline production exporter
shared_golden_head_only.actual_identity: Existing approved class-owned full-body art already depicts one common blonde-haired protagonist
shared_golden_head_only.source_stage: no head paste, mask, per-head offset or artificial neck reposition permitted
shared_golden_head_only.hard_release_check: Every approved authored keyframe must be byte-identical to crop_frame(original class-owned source atlas). Hair color, head dimensions and outfit socket are inspected per profession/facing.

full_body_source_contract.unity_runtime: PRODUCTION: DrawPlayerActor samples one complete class-owned published Hero_{class}_{action}_{facing}.png Sprite per hero draw; no UnifiedActionGait, dynamic leg/hip warp or HumanActor head splice. Moving released recovery samples the complete class Walk/Run cell.
full_body_source_contract.unity_safety: Gameplay and Unity-native capture share ResolveFullBodyHeroFrame and one (128,240) original foot reference. If GPU path fails, OnGUI draws one complete published full-body frame; if a published atlas is missing, original class-owned full-body cell is used. OnGUI remains the verified default until native Unity QA.
full_body_source_contract.native_verification: Unity 2022.3.53f1 PlayMode and visual grip/waist inspection not yet run

runtime_transition.mode: FullBodyProductionSprites (OnGUI full-frame default, SpriteRenderer+Animator compatible F8 native lane)
runtime_transition.canonical_resources: Assets/Resources/Frontier/HeroAnimator/Canonical/ (original class-owned blonde-haired full-body frames only; no runtime/offline graft)
runtime_transition.frame_clock: ResolveFullBodyHeroFrame(wholeBodyRun, facing) shared by native and fallback
runtime_transition.attack_mobility: Full-body attack/skill keyframe until authoritative release, complete same-class Run after reduced-speed moving recovery begins
prohibited_runtime_patterns: offline canonical_frame masks/cuts source head and overlays WalkVanguard face
runtime_transition.scene_binding: FrontierRuntime.Boot() subscribes sceneLoaded and adds live MonoBehaviour for Assets/Scenes/Frontier.unity; FrontierEditor builds this scene
runtime_transition.native_qa_status: NATIVE_UNVERIFIED; do not enable native capture by default without actual Unity 2022.3.53f1 Game View + PlayMode
runtime_transition.runtime_art_gate: tools/check_hero_runtime_continuity.py validates real 63 PNGs and emits 22 representative production filmstrips/GIFs/onion-skins; metrics alone do not approve authored animation
runtime_transition.full_body_source_qa: Source-original RGBA crop vs generated full body byte exact, with per-class hair color/neck region checks (tools/check_hero_visual_spec.py, tools/check_hero_whole_body_integrity.py).
